compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Virtual Lighter." The main content of the screen displays a virtual lighter with a customizable design. The central part of the screen shows a large image of the lighter with a specific design. Below the lighter, there is a horizontal scrollable menu featuring various lighter designs that users can choose from. Each design is represented by a small thumbnail image. The top of the screen has a title bar with the text "Virtual Lighter," indicating the name of the app. The bottom of the screen contains standard navigation buttons for the device.
